extracted.name: Quick Savory Grilled Peaches
extracted.description: These savory grilled peaches seasoned with fresh herbs are a quick and easy summer side dish that pairs perfectly with grilled meats.
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat a grill for medium heat and lightly oil the grate.
Whisk olive oil, basil, thyme, salt, and pepper together in a bowl. Allow flavors to meld for 5 minutes. Brush oil mixture over the cut side of each peach half.
Grill peaches, cut-sides down, on the preheated grill until softened and grill marks appear, about 4 minutes.
